parameters: Guess they're keepin' this place as a memorial.\! World's got just about enough of 'em.\! Ain't no medal gonna bring these boys back...
Brave young ones...\| yer the best among us.\| Donar bless 'em, each and every one...
\n[8]...\| I ain't got much left in me, but I reckon you do.\! Don't waste this...\| you know how it goes with war...\| you can fix it.
